jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, DynamoDB
jobs.description: Want to help shape the future of one of the largest NoSQL database services on the planet? The Amazon DynamoDB team is looking for deeply technical, team-first-mentality full stack software engineers who are willing to commit themselves to our goal to grow the business 10 times over the next 2 years. DynamoDB is a key-value database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads. DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers. You will be responsible to maintain a high bar in terms of execution, operational readiness, code and design quality. You will serve as a mentor for junior engineers and help them grow. You are comfortable working with other seasoned DynamoDB engineers and hold your ground during design and customer experience reviews. This is a hands-on position where you will own everything from end to end: design, design reviews, implementation, code reviews, iterative feature launches, operations, mentoring, driving continuous improvement, and more. Key job responsibilities Our engineers collaborate across diverse teams, projects, and environments to have a firsthand impact on our global customer base. You’ll bring a passion for innovation, data, search, analytics, and distributed systems. You’ll also: - Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack. - Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions. - Build high-quality, secure, performant, highly available, always-on products. - Automate and improve repetitive operational processes. - Deep dive and continuously improve performance to deliver superior customer experience. - Scale distributed systems with optimal balance between performance and cost. A day in the life As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You’ll also: - Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base. - Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. - Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. - Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff. About the team About the team Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. About AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, WA, Seattle - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: The Off-Search Online Sourcing team builds the real-time ad retrieval systems behind every Detail Page, Home Page, and non-Search surface on Amazon — searching hundreds of millions of ads in milliseconds using embedding models and approximate nearest neighbor indexes. You'll design and deliver the low-latency services, model serving infrastructure, and distributed indexing pipelines that determine which ads shoppers see, enriched with delivery speed, locality, and return signals so ads surface products that can reach customers quickly. This is a team that ships fast — rapidly experimenting with new models, indexes, and signals in production through A/B experiments to grow both advertiser results and shopper engagement. You'll partner closely with applied scientists to bring new retrieval models from research into production, and use experimental results to decide what ships. Key job responsibilities - Design and develop high-throughput, low-latency services that retrieve and enrich ad candidates within strict latency budgets across Amazon's non-Search surfaces - Build and scale model serving infrastructure for real-time embedding inference, partnering with applied scientists to bring new retrieval models into production - Develop distributed indexing pipelines that build and refresh large approximate nearest neighbor search indexes across hundreds of millions of ads - Deliver real-time fulfillment signals — delivery speed, locality, return eligibility — that improve ad filtering and ranking quality for shoppers - Launch new retrieval models and indexes behind A/B experiments, analyze results, and use data to decide what ships to production - Deliver features end to end — from design and code reviews through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and on-call operations - Improve operational excellence through caching, graceful degradation, monitoring, and root-cause analysis - Mentor peers through code and design reviews, helping raise the engineering quality bar across the team A day in the life On a typical day you might start by reviewing latency dashboards for your retrieval services, then dive into building a new distributed pipeline to refresh a nearest neighbor index. After lunch, you could be partnering with an applied scientist to integrate a new embedding model into the serving path, setting up the A/B experiment framework to measure its impact. Between coding sessions, you'll review pull requests, debug a latency regression, and check on the results of a running experiment to decide whether a new signal improves shopper engagement enough to ship. About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry-leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. The Off-Search Online Sourcing team within SPB builds the real-time systems that choose which ads shoppers see on the Detail Page, Home Page, and other Amazon pages — searching hundreds of millions of ads in milliseconds using embedding models and approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and enriching every candidate with delivery speed, locality, and return signals so shoppers see ads for products that can reach them quickly. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent - Experience building low-latency, high-throughput distributed services - Experience with search or vector retrieval systems, such as Lucene, Elasticsearch or approximate nearest neighbor indexes - Experience serving machine learning or generative AI models in production - Experience with large-scale data processing, such as Spark - Background in advertising technology, recommendation systems or e-commerce platforms The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Applied Scientist - AI Experiences Search
jobs.description: Overview The Microsoft AI Web Data team is seeking an Applied Scientist to help build the next-generation platform for Bing and Microsoft AI. The Microsoft AIX Web Data Platform (WDP) team builds the data foundation that powers Bing and Microsoft AI experiences, including large-scale grounding and large language model (LLM) training. We operate end-to-end systems that discover, crawl, process, understand and store web content on the internet scale. We advance the platform’s capabilities with state-of-the-art modeling and fueling critical Microsoft experiences and pushing the frontier of AI. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys tackling deep technical challenges and driving industry-wide impact. In this role, you will translate research into production by advancing the state of the art and applying it to meet today’s AI needs. You will drive the design, development, execution, and implementation of research projects, using scientific principles and techniques to develop, evaluate, and deploy algorithms and solutions that improve system performance, quality, data management, and accuracy. Join us to shape the future of AI and deliver meaningful value to millions of users. At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone. Responsibilities Own end-to-end applied research and engineering to improve web data quality, scale, and model readiness for Search, grounding, and LLM training. Develop and apply state-of-the-art machine learning, LLM, statistical, and data mining techniques to solve complex web-scale problems and advance platform capabilities. Analyze large-scale web data, formulate hypotheses, and design rigorous experiments that produce trustworthy, actionable insights and measurable impact. Apply LLMs and prompt engineering to score, classify, label, and evaluate data, enabling scalable model training, evaluation, and continuous improvement. Translate complex technical problems and research findings into product decisions, technical strategies, and engineering roadmap in partnership with stakeholders. Collaborate across Microsoft AI, document and share learnings, and establish best practices for scalable, responsible, and privacy-conscious AI and data solutions. Qualifications Required Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 2+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research) OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1+ year(s) related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research) OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field OR equivalent experience. Preferred Qualifications: 1+ years of experience contributing to research publications, patents, or peer-reviewed academic papers. 1+ years of experience in product development in machine learning and related areas. Hands-on experience developing algorithms and models using deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorchHands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), such as GPT, BERT, or similar architectures, with an understanding of their capabilities and limitations. Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), including tokenization, semantic understanding, representation learning, classification, and text generation. Understanding of modern machine learning and deep learning techniques, with hands-on experience using architectures such as Transformers/Attention, DNNs, CNNs, or RNNs and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras. Algorithmic, statistical, and analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to apply advanced techniques to complex, real-world problems. Ability to translate technical vision into experimentation, system design, implementation, and measurable results, working both independently and collaboratively across teams. Experience with large-scale or distributed data processing, high-performance computing, stream processing, or SCOPE is preferred.
